title: PBH 103 - Health Policy, Planning and Financing

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Prepayment.
o: money paid for health before illness occurs, as in insurance
keeping the cost of illness from ruining a household's finances
the detailed schedule of activities, people and costs for carrying out a plan
the first level of care, close to people's homes and the entry to the wider system
items.s: Prepayment: money paid for health before illness occurs, as in insurance. The other options describe Primary health care, Operational plan, Financial protection.

items.s: Health sector reform: deliberate change to the structure and rules of a health system. The other options describe Programme sustainability, Fee for service, Health workforce.

items.s: Essential medicines: the medicines a health system undertakes to make available to those who need them. The other options describe Cold chain, Immunisation programme, Integrated programme.
